name: OpenVibe.Actor

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database and the agent backends are what ready checks)

drains: running tasks cancelled and recorded as failed (actor.task.interrupted)

resumes.what: a task left queued, running or verifying by a stopped process is marked failed with actor.task.interrupted at boot; nothing is re-run without the person asking
OpenVibe.Events redelivers network.account.export_requested and network.account.deleted that were pending during the stop (at least once; account_data_events applies each export and deletion once)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migration 0001 only creates Actor's own tables; an earlier release has none to read

leases.none: no claims: a task runs in the process that accepted it

notes: Port 4950, unit openvibe-actor.service. OpenVibe's own general agent and the router for agent work (plan T17, ADR-044): POST /api/v1/tasks takes a task in plain words, a mode and a budget; the planner (openvibe-sdk/placement) picks an agent system, runs it, has a second model family check the result and answers with the result, the cost and the explanation (platform.task@1). Agent systems: the OpenVibe runtime (a tool-using model that acts through OpenVibe services: Search, Tools), other platforms' agents (OpenAI's Responses agent with web search) and an open model on OpenVibe's own hardware for private mode; coding work goes to OpenVibe.Codes. Consumes OpenVibe.Network (SSO with PKCE S256 as OAuth client actor, JWKS for app and person tokens), OpenVibe.Search (public reads) and OpenVibe.Tools (tools.tool.run). Owns its tasks and their event logs; model provider keys are the operator's (BYO keys through OpenVibe.AI come next). Ask Actor from chat (plan T17 reach): a signed-in person's "@actor <task>" in OpenVibe's global chat or their own channel (chat.message.created) becomes their task with public tools only (never their computers, robots or code), and the answer is posted back in the room through OpenVibe.Chat's service API (chat.message.send).

site.name: Actor
site.tagline: Agents that work while you are away
site.what: Agents that run tasks for you, now or on a schedule, on OpenVibe's own agent or another platform's, on your computers and robots when you allow it, with every result checked and its cost shown.
